title: Resilience Requires Creativity: Why the Organizations Built to Survive Uncertainty Aren't Necessarily the Ones Built for Efficiency
description:
Today's businesses face volatility, uncertainty, complexity, and ambiguity at a scale few organizations were designed to handle. Yet when uncertainty rises, our instinct is often to seek more control: optimize processes, reduce risk, eliminate waste, and make outcomes increasingly predictable. That instinct may be making organizations more fragile.

Drawing from ongoing graduate research at Parsons School of Design, two decades of creative leadership, and conversations with leaders across design, innovation, and business, Christopher A. Ritter explores creativity as more than a source of ideas. It is an organizational capacity for adaptation.

This talk examines why resilient organizations protect curiosity, experimentation, candor, judgment, and the freedom to explore what isn't yet known—and why the ability to create may ultimately matter more than the ability to predict.

Sponsored By Notion

description:
